participant_id.Description: pseudonymized identification code for each participant

Levels.withPCS: participants with subjective cognitive impairment asked by trained medical staff during the COVIDOM study
Levels.withoutPCS: participants without subjective cognitive impairment asked by trained medical staff during the COVIDOM study

years_of_education.Description: years of graduation of the participant as counted by the MoCA

neurological_diseases_1.Description: Does the participant have any previous neurological diseases

tmt_a_time.Description: time needed to finish TMT A

tmt_b_time.Description: time needed to finish TMT B

facit_f_FS.Description: sum of points in the fatigue subscale of the FACIT-F questionnaire

hads_a_total_score.Description: sum of points in the HADS-A questions. Higher scores mean more anxiety symptoms

hads_d_total_score.Description: sum of points in the HADS-D questions. Higher scores mean more depression symptoms

psqi_total_score.Description: sum of points in the PSQI questionnaire. Higher scores mean more sleep disorder symptoms

pvt_reaction_time.Description: average time between stimulus Onset and button press in the psychomotor vigilance test

nback_miss_1.Description: number of times that the participant did not react to a target before the next stimulus started in the 1-back task

Levels.clinically relevant fatigue: participants with a score of 30 or less in the FACIT-F fatigue subscale
Levels.no clinically relevant fatigue: participants with a score of more than 30 in the FACIT-F fatigue subscale

alpha_peak_power_Pre.Description: maximum power between 8 and 12 Hz, calculated across all channels after removing the aperiodic component from the power spectrum, during the one-second period preceding stimulus onset in the PVT

theta_peak_power_Pre.Description: maximum power between 4 and 7 Hz, calculated across all channels after removing the aperiodic component from the power spectrum, during the one-second period preceding stimulus onset in the PVT

alpha_peak_power_Post.Description: maximum power between 8 and 12 Hz, calculated across all channels after removing the aperiodic component from the power spectrum, during the one-second period after stimulus onset in the PVT

theta_peak_power_Post.Description: maximum power between 4 and 7 Hz, calculated across all channels after removing the aperiodic component from the power spectrum, during the one-second period after stimulus onset in the PVT

bad_trials.Description: number of trials that were removed based on pop_jointprob (EEGlab) per participant before calculation of powerspectra

bad_channels.Description: number of channels that were removed based on deviation from median channel variance per participant before calculation of ICA

bad_segments.Description: number of segments that were removed based on deviation from z-score per participant before calculation of ICA
